entities.summary: Ernestina Edem Appiah is a Ghanaian social entrepreneur. She founded the Ghana Code Club as an after-school program to teach children how to write computer programs. In 2015, she was named to the "BBC 100 Most Inspirational Women" list for her work to promote computing in Ghana.
